news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.97 (down from ₹18.33 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹42.4b (up 5.1% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹718.0m (down 78% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 1.7% (down from 8.2% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 1.2%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 56%. Revenue is forecast to grow 6.5% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Metals and Mining industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 17% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 22% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: Ramkrishna Forgings Limited Declares First Interim Dividend for the Financial Year 2025-26
news.body: Ramkrishna Forgings Limited, at the board meeting held on 1 May 2026, declared first Interim Dividend of INR 1/- (Rupee One) per Equity Share of face value INR 2/- (Rupees Two) each for the Financial Year 2025-26. Fixed 8 May, 2026 as the Record Date for the purpose of payment of 15 interim Dividend for the Financial Year 2025-26 to be paid to the eligible shareholders.
